info.name: Academic Operations & Payroll API
info.description: Comprehensive Postman collection for academic operations, instructor reporting, approval workflows, and payroll automation. Import it with the accompanying sanitized Postman environment. Response scripts populate generated IDs and authentication tokens during the workflow, and a targeted pre-request delay respects the API login throttle during full collection runs.

item.name: Approve Session Report 5 - Small Late Penalty

request.description:
### Scenario notes

AUGUST PAYROLL - FINAL MISSING APPROVAL:

Session 5 start = 2026-08-26 04:00 UTC
Duration = 90 min
Session end = 2026-08-26 05:30 UTC

Free grace period = 48 hours
Grace deadline = 2026-08-28 05:30 UTC

If final approval is AFTER the deadline:
late_hours = any fraction rounded UP to a full hour.

Penalty = 1% of this session amount per late hour,
capped at 100%.

### Scenario notes

Teacher 5 base wage = 200
Both sessions = 90 min → 100%
Summer Term → +10%

SESSION 5:
200 × 1.00 × 1.10 = 220 gross
Late penalty depends on final approval time.

SESSION 6:
200 × 1.00 × 1.10 = 220 gross
Approved within 48h → late_hours = 0 → penalty = 0

TOTAL GROSS:
220 + 220 = 440

FINAL:
Net Salary = 440 - Total Late Penalty

Example if Session 5 is exactly 1 late hour:
Penalty = 220 × 1% = 2.20
Net = 440 - 2.20 = 437.80
